corrections: MIT gives class of 2003 and MEng 2005, with EECS field corroborated by EDN and Wikipedia. MEng is not a doctorate.
Adafruit, Eyebeam and Entrepreneur date founding to 2005. MIT separates 2005 kit sales and later formal New York opening; no conflation of founding, relocation or incorporation date.

MIT 2013 story places WIRED cover in the previous year; actual March 31, 2011 WIRED announcement and May 13, 2011 EDN interview establish April 2011 issue. Dossier avoids an unnecessary first-ever claim.
Entrepreneur article dated December 18, 2012 explicitly names Entrepreneur of 2012. January 2013 discussion in MIT is not a different award year or proof of original announcement date.
Red Hat announcement May 6, 2019 identifies community category, distinct from Saloni Garg’s academic award and later 2020 award pages.

EFF archive URL contains October 5 while secondary citations say October 6; readable body has no explicit publication dateline. Month precision used. October 22 planned ceremony is not evidence of attendance.

First summit date September 23, 2010 corroborated by attendee Chris Gammell and Red Hat oral history. Alicia Gibb and Ayah Bdeir organized it; Fried is a speaker and participant, not sole founder of the movement.
Mozilla May 21, 2026 describes desktop Firefox 151 Web Serial validation with Adafruit. No unsupported claim Fried personally implemented browser functionality or all devices work.
March 9, 2026 episode distinguishes shipped boards/libraries from work in progress. Apple and first-party index descriptions read; YouTube exposes no substantive text and audio/video not watched.

Birth year 1979 appears in secondary-language search snippets but was not independently confirmed. No exact date asserted. Historical employee, revenue and certification figures on undated company/Eyebeam pages are not treated as 2026 figures.

Forbes 2026 company blog open returned 403; search excerpt not enough for an independently checked ranking and omitted. No unsupported IEEE award, Raspberry Pi co-founder or sole CircuitPython-author claim.
